description:
PearGuard is a privacy-focused, peer-to-peer parental control app. The parent device pairs directly with the child device — no accounts, no servers, no subscriptions. Your family's activity data lives only on the devices you pair.

PearGuard is designed for families where the child uses an Android device. The parent can use Android or iOS.

FEATURES

Screen Time Limits
Set daily time budgets and bedtime windows on the child device.

Per-App Policies
Allow, block, or time-limit individual apps by category or one at a time.

Activity View
See what's been used and when, directly from the parent device.

Time Requests
The child can request extra time; the parent approves or denies from their device.

Privacy First
No account creation. No email address. No tracking. No ads. Activity never leaves the paired devices.

Open Source
PearGuard is free and open source. Source code is available on GitHub.

PERMISSIONS

Camera — used to scan QR invite codes when pairing with a child device.
Photo Library — used to set profile photos.
whatsNew:
## What's Changed

  ### Improvements
  
  - staying connected away from home: if your child is on mobile data or a network that blocks direct connections, PearGuard now routes through a helper so
  alerts still arrive and rule changes still reach them. It always tries the direct connection first and only falls back when it has to, and nothing
  readable passes through the helper.
  - a new Connection section in Settings shows whether the helper is being used and lets you turn the fallback off for your own device if you prefer.
  - Settings is easier to find your way around: the page is now grouped under Your profile, What your children see, This device and Data, instead of one
  long list of equal-looking sections.

  ### Bug Fixes
  
  - changes in Settings now save the moment you make them, with a confirmation right next to what you changed. Previously the time request and warning
  options only saved if you scrolled to the bottom and tapped Save Settings, so a change you made and walked away from was quietly lost.
